'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Eastern Ukraine offensive]]
****[[Battle of Sievierodonetsk (2022)|Battle of Sievierodonetsk]]
*****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] shell [[Sievierodonetsk]], [[Luhansk Oblast]], setting ten [[high-rise building]]s on fire. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2022/apr/06/russia-ukraine-war-latest-fresh-sanctions-loom-as-ukraine-says-more-than-4000-alleged-war-crimes-being-investigated-live?page=with:block-624d7e1e8f081f653cd8a225-pinned#block-624d7e1e8f081f653cd8a225-pinned (''The Guardian'')]
****Four civilians are reported to have been killed by the [[Russia]]n military in [[Vuhledar]], [[Donetsk Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraines-luhansk-region-tells-civilians-evacuate-while-they-can-2022-04-06/ (Reuters)]
***[[Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
****Russia says it will end its invasion if [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] agrees to conditions set during negotiations, specifically a legal guarantee that Ukraine will not join [[NATO]] by changing the [[Ukrainian constitution]] to include such a provision. Russia also says it [[Kyiv offensive (2022)|suspended operations]] in [[Kyiv]] as a "goodwill gesture" in order to promote peace talks. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/ukraine-russia-lists-goodwill-gesture-for-talks-but-has-a-condition-to-end-war-101649239938256.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
*[[Afghan conflict|Afghanistan conflict]]
**A hand [[grenade]] is thrown into the [[Pul-e Khishti Mosque]] in [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]], killing at least one person and injuring five others. [https://www.laprensalatina.com/at-least-1-dead-5-wounded-in-attack-on-mosque-in-afghan-capital/ (La Prensa Latina)] [https://www.dw.com/en/afghanistan-explosion-at-major-kabul-mosque-injures-several/a-61377069 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[Iraqi conflict]]
**Three missiles land near an [[oil refinery]] in [[Erbil]], [[Iraqi Kurdistan]]. Two [[America]]n security personnel are injured. [https://www.reuters.com/world/two-us-personnel-injured-syria-attack-officials-2022-04-07/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Four [[Europeans]] go missing after a diving trip off the coast of [[Mersing]], in the [[Johor]] state of [[Malaysia]]. Authorities say that a search operation is ongoing and one person has since been rescued. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/apr/07/two-britons-are-among-four-tourists-missing-after-diving-trip-in-malaysia (''The Guardian'')] [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/malaysia-searches-europeans-lost-dive-training-83924357 (ABC News)]

*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
****[[United States Attorney General|U.S. Attorney General]] [[Merrick Garland]] and [[United States Secretary of Commerce|U.S. Commerce Secretary]] [[Gina Raimondo]] test positive for [[COVID-19]] after attending the [[Gridiron Club]]'s annual dinner in [[Washington, D.C.]]. Several other attendees also tested positive. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna23290 (NBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A man dies after [[Vehicle-ramming attack|ramming his vehicle]] into the fence of the [[Romania–Russia relations|Russian Embassy]] in [[Bucharest]], [[Romania]] and [[Self-immolation|setting himself on fire]]. [https://gazetadecluj.ro/un-pedofil-care-si-a-abuzat-copilul-s-a-incendiat-si-a-intrat-cu-masina-in-ambasada-rusiei-la-bucuresti/ (''Gazeta de Cluj'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/man-dies-crashing-car-into-russian-embassy-romanian-capital-2022-04-06/ (Reuters)]
*Former [[President of Burkina Faso]] [[Blaise Compaoré]] is found guilty of complicity in the murder of the country's first president, [[Thomas Sankara]], and is sentenced ''in absentia'' to [[life imprisonment]]. Compaoré has been in exile in [[Ivory Coast]] ever since resigning to the presidency following the [[2014 Burkina Faso uprising]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/apr/06/burkina-faso-ex-president-blaise-compaore-guilty-thomas-sankara (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Poland]] arrests two [[Belarus]]ian citizens on charges of spying for [[Government of Belarus|Minsk]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/poland-arrests-two-belarusians-suspected-spying-minsk-statement-2022-04-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2019–2022 Sudanese protests]]
**A protester is shot dead as security forces confront anti-coup [[political demonstration|demonstrations]] in the state of [[Khartoum (state)|Khartoum]], [[Sudan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/one-protester-shot-dead-by-security-forces-sudans-khartoum-medics-2022-04-06/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Thirty-sixth government of Israel|governing coalition]] of [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Naftali Bennett]] loses its majority in the [[Knesset]] after [[Whip (politics)|coalition whip]] [[Idit Silman]] of the [[Yamina]] party defects to the opposition [[Likud]] party, raising the possibility of new [[elections in Israel]] for the fifth time in four years. [https://www.axios.com/israeli-government-coalition-collapse-21df1f2e-3f52-4369-b426-31d9a995d2bc.html (''Axios'')]
